generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Bidder should have valid Class-3 and above Registered Electrical Contractor License issued from Inspectorate of Electricity.
The bidder should submit the GST/PAN Registration Certificate.

Tenderer in their name should submit annual turnover certificate any two years from last five years 2021-22 to 2025-26 of Rs.2.25 Lakhs in each year. Turn over certificate should be mandatorily certified from charted accountant and mention UDIN number is compulsory, otherwise it will be subjected to rejection

Tenderers shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by the Government of Karnataka /any Govt. Agency/ULBs/PSU. The bidder should submit self declaration for the same.

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Installing solar lights on existing poles at Mahatma Gandhi Park in Ward 21 of Shivamogga City Corporation

itemList.description: Supply, installation, testing and commissioning of a 60-watt Semi integrated solar LED street light comprising an IP66/IK08-rated die-cast aluminium LED luminaire with a minimum efficacy of 140 lm/W and a total luminous output of 8,400 lumens, powered by a 160-200 Wp monocrystalline solar PV panel and an in-built LiFePO4 battery pack comprising 3.2 V. 12 Ah lithium iron phosphate cells, configured to provide 12.8 V, 60 Ah (768 Wh) LiFePO4 battery nominal battery capacity, complete with an integrated BMS, automatic dusk-to-dawn MPPT charge controller, and all necessary mounting accessories, cables, connectors and protection devices, providing suitable system autonomy, complete with all components required for proper operation, installation, testing and commissioning on a pole up to 9 meters height
